Bấm để máy tự động đọc lần lượt từng từ và hiển thị theo dõi (phù hợp học trên điện thoại)
1. norm (n)
/nɔːm/
chuẩn mực xã hội, quy tắc ứng xử chung (social norms)
Collocation: social norms, cultural norms, conform to social norms
"Respecting elderly citizens and queuing politely are deeply ingrained social norms in many cultures."
2. conform (v)
/kənˈfɔːm/
tuân theo, hòa nhập theo số đông/quy chuẩn (đi với TO/WITH — n: conformity)
Collocation: conform to peer pressure, conform to social expectations
"Teenagers often feel intense pressure to conform to the fashion choices of their peer group."
3. peer (n)
/pɪə(r)/
bạn đồng trang lứa, đồng nghiệp cùng cấp (peer pressure = áp lực đồng trang lứa)
Collocation: peer pressure, peer group, influence of peers
"Positive peer pressure in a study group can motivate lazy students to work much harder."
4. altruism (n)
/ˈæltruɪzəm/
lòng vị tha, sự hy sinh vì người khác không vụ lợi (adj: altruistic)
Collocation: pure altruism, acts of altruism, altruistic behaviour
"Donating blood anonymously to save strangers is a powerful example of human altruism."
5. empathy (n)
/ˈempəθi/
sự thấu cảm, khả năng đặt mình vào hoàn cảnh của người khác (adj: empathetic)
Collocation: show empathy for, cultivate empathy, deep empathy
"Volunteering at homeless shelters helps young people develop deep empathy for the disadvantaged."
6. egoism (n)
/ˈiːɡəʊɪzəm/
chủ nghĩa vị kỷ, tính ích kỷ chỉ nghĩ cho bản thân (adj: egoistic / selfish)
Collocation: Growing egoism, hyper-individualism and egoism
"Sociologists warn that excessive materialism can breed egoism and weaken community bonds."
7. compassion (n)
/kəmˈpæʃn/
lòng trắc ẩn, tình thương cảm muốn giúp đỡ người gặp nạn (adj: compassionate)
Collocation: treat others with compassion, show compassion towards victims
"During devastating floods, citizens across the country showed immense compassion by donating food."
8. incentive (n)
/ɪnˈsentɪv/
động lực khuyến khích, phần thưởng khích lệ (kinh tế hoặc tinh thần)
Collocation: financial incentive, tax incentive, provide an incentive to
"Tax rebates provide a strong financial incentive for households to install solar panels."
9. motive (n)
/ˈməʊtɪv/
động cơ thúc đẩy hành động (v: motivate — thúc đẩy, truyền động lực)
Collocation: ulterior motive, primary motive, motivated by kindness
"Whether charitable donations are driven by pure empathy or a desire for fame remains a debate."
10. innate (adj)
/ɪˈneɪt/
bẩm sinh, vốn có từ khi sinh ra (= inborn)
Collocation: innate kindness, innate talent, innate human desire
"Psychologists have discovered that even toddlers possess an innate desire to help others."
11. ethical (adj)
/ˈeθɪkl/
có đạo đức, hợp chuẩn mực đạo lý (n: ethics — đạo đức học)
Collocation: ethical behaviour, ethical dilemma, ethical responsibility
"Schools must teach ethical values alongside academic subjects to shape responsible citizens."
12. cohesion (n)
/kəʊˈhiːʒn/
sự gắn kết, sự đoàn kết chặt chẽ (social cohesion = sự gắn kết xã hội)
Collocation: social cohesion, strengthen community cohesion
"Shared neighbourhood festivals and volunteer projects strengthen social cohesion in big cities."
13. bonds (n)
/bɒndz/
sợi dây gắn kết, mối liên kết tình cảm (family / community bonds)
Collocation: strengthen family bonds, close social bonds, weaken bonds
"Eating dinner together every evening strengthens family bonds between parents and children."
14. isolation (n)
/ˌaɪsəˈleɪʃn/
sự cô lập, sự tách biệt khỏi xã hội (v: isolate, adj: isolated)
Collocation: social isolation, live in isolation, combat isolation
"Elderly people who live alone in high-rise apartments often suffer from severe social isolation."
15. mutual (adj)
/ˈmjuːtʃuəl/
lẫn nhau, qua lại đôi bên cùng có lợi (mutual trust / mutual respect)
Collocation: mutual respect, mutual trust, for mutual benefit
"A harmonious society is built upon mutual respect, empathy, and cooperation among citizens."

⚙️ 2. Bài Giảng Ngữ Pháp 2 Tầng (Grammar Masterclass)

🟢 Tầng 1: Câu Chẻ Nhấn Mạnh 'What + V + is...' (Wh-Cleft Sentences) — Vũ Khí Band 7.5+ GRA

• Tại sao giám khảo IELTS cực kỳ đánh giá cao Câu Chẻ (Cleft Sentences)? Thay vì viết câu phẳng Mutual trust strengthens social cohesion, câu chẻ mở đầu bằng What + (S) + V + is/was + Noun / that S + V giúp nhấn mạnh luận điểm chính của bạn một cách học thuật:

• Công thức 1 (What làm Chủ ngữ): What + V (số ít) + Object + is + Noun / V-ing / that S + V
  Ví dụ: What binds a community together is mutual trust and compassion.
  Ví dụ: What motivates young people to volunteer is an innate sense of empathy.

• Công thức 2 (What làm Tân ngữ): What + S + V + is + (to) V / that S + V
  Ví dụ: What modern cities need most is to rebuild social cohesion and combat isolation.

🔵 Tầng 2: Đảo Ngữ Với 'Not Only... But Also...' (Negative Inversion for Emphasis)

• Công thức Đảo ngữ đặt 'Not only' ở đầu câu (Chỉ cần dùng đúng 1 câu trong bài Essay là ăn điểm tuyệt đối tiêu chí Grammatical Range):
  Not only + do / does / did / can + S + V (nguyên mẫu), but + S + also + V...
  Ví dụ 1: Not only do acts of altruism help vulnerable people, but they also enhance the giver's psychological wellbeing.
  Ví dụ 2: Not only does positive peer pressure encourage good habits, but it also strengthens social bonds.

🎯 20 Câu Test Từ Vựng (Vocabulary Mastery Test)

1. Taking off your shoes before entering a house is a common social ________ in Vietnam and Japan.
2. Adolescents often feel anxious if they do not ________ to the clothing styles of their classmates.
3. Strong ________ pressure can either push teenagers towards risky behaviour or inspire them to study harder.
4. Firefighters who risk their own lives to rescue strangers demonstrate extraordinary ________.
5. Listening carefully to a friend's problems requires genuine ________ and emotional maturity.
6. Critics argue that ruthless competition in modern capitalism promotes selfishness and ________.
7. Doctors and nurses must treat terminally ill patients with both medical skill and deep ________.
8. Lower registration taxes act as a financial ________ for drivers to switch to electric vehicles.
9. The police detective questioned the suspect to discover the true ________ behind the cybercrime.
10. Experiments with young infants suggest that human beings have an ________ sense of fairness and kindness.
11. Medical researchers must follow strict ________ guidelines to ensure that clinical trials do not harm patients.
12. High levels of inequality and distrust can weaken social ________ and lead to civil unrest.
13. Volunteering at local community gardens helps neighbours form lasting friendships and strong social ________.
14. Working remotely from home every day without meeting colleagues can lead to a feeling of social ________.
15. Every successful marriage and business partnership is founded on ________ trust and respect.
16. [Ôn tập Unit 24] Chronic sleep deprivation is highly ________ to a student's memory and mental health.
17. [Ôn tập Unit 23] Social media algorithms are often blamed for spreading fake news and ________.
18. [Ôn tập Unit 22] Despite not bringing immediate profit, classical literature ________ our spiritual lives.
19. [Ôn tập Unit 21] In 2025, working-age adults accounted for the vast ________ (66%) of the population.
20. [Ôn tập Unit 20] There was a striking ________ in daily water consumption between rich and poor countries.

3. Teenagers often feel compelled to conform ________ the social norms of their peer group.
4. Not only ________ positive peer pressure encourage good study habits, but it also builds character.

💡 Bấm vào bất kỳ câu thoại nào để nghe riêng câu đó:
👨 Charity Director: Good morning, Bridges of Compassion Community Network, Director Victor Hayes speaking. How may I help you?
👩 Volunteer Applicant: Hello Mr. Hayes! My name is Elena Rostova. I moved to this city two months ago, and I would love to join your neighbourhood volunteering programme.
👨 Charity Director: Welcome to the city, Elena! Volunteering is the best way to build social bonds. Could you spell your surname for our registration system?
👩 Volunteer Applicant: Yes, it is Rostova. R - O - S - T - O - V - A. 💡 Đáp án câu 1 (Họ tình nguyện viên): ROSTOVA
👨 Charity Director: Thank you. What motivated you to apply to Bridges of Compassion?
👩 Volunteer Applicant: I work remotely from my apartment, so I want to help the community while overcoming social isolation.
👨 Charity Director: Many young professionals feel the same way! Our most impactful programme pairs young volunteers with elderly residents to combat loneliness. 💡 Đáp án câu 2 (Kết nối tình nguyện viên trẻ với ai): elderly residents / elderly
👩 Volunteer Applicant: What activities do volunteers do with the senior residents during the week?
👨 Charity Director: Every Wednesday evening, we host a Shared Community Dinner where neighbours cook together and share stories. 💡 Đáp án câu 3 (Sự kiện tối thứ Tư): Community Dinner / Dinner
👩 Volunteer Applicant: That sounds wonderful for strengthening social cohesion! Do you also run a weekend tutoring project for teenagers?
👨 Charity Director: Yes! On Saturday mornings, we mentor high school students to help them resist negative peer pressure and prepare for university. 💡 Đáp án câu 4 (Giúp học sinh vượt qua áp lực gì): peer pressure
👩 Volunteer Applicant: How many hours a month are volunteers expected to commit?
👨 Charity Director: We ask for a minimum commitment of 16 hours per month, which is just four hours a week. 💡 Bẫy số giờ/tuần (4) vs số giờ tối thiểu mỗi tháng câu 5: 16
👩 Volunteer Applicant: Sixteen hours a month fits my schedule perfectly. Where does the orientation session take place this Saturday?
👨 Charity Director: Orientation starts at 9:30 AM at Harmony Hall, right across from the train station. We look forward to meeting you, Elena! 💡 Đáp án câu 6 (Địa điểm định hướng): Harmony Hall

📰 IELTS Academic Reading: Passage & Questions

[Paragraph A - The Rise of Urban Individualism and Egoism]
Many sociologists argue that rapid urbanization and consumer capitalism have made modern society increasingly self-centred. In previous generations, people lived in tight-knit villages where strict social norms and extended family bonds required neighbours to support one another. Today, millions of urban dwellers live alone in high-rise apartments and interact primarily through digital screens. Critics claim that this hyper-individualism breeds egoism, weakens social cohesion, and leaves vulnerable citizens—particularly the elderly—suffering from acute social isolation.

[Paragraph B - Scientific Evidence of Innate Human Empathy and Altruism]
Despite these pessimistic observations, evolutionary biologists and psychologists maintain that human beings are not naturally selfish. Behavioral experiments demonstrate that even eighteen-month-old toddlers display an innate impulse to comfort a crying stranger without any external reward or financial incentive. Throughout history, what has enabled humanity to survive harsh environments is our capacity for empathy, mutual cooperation, and altruism. Whenever natural disasters or floods strike, ordinary citizens consistently donate money, blood, and time out of pure compassion.

[Paragraph C - Fostering Ethical Behavior and Positive Peer Norms]
Furthermore, human behaviour is strongly shaped by the environment and peer influence. Because individuals have a psychological desire to conform to group expectations, schools and governments can cultivate ethical values by making kindness the visible social norm. Not only does community volunteering strengthen neighbourhood bonds, but it also improves the volunteer's own mental wellbeing, proving that helping others is ultimately the best way to help ourselves.
Điểm: 0/6

✍️ Academic Writing Lab (Task 2 Discussion — Tổng Duyệt Chặng 5): Con Người Ngày Nay Ngày Càng Ích Kỷ (Egoism) Hay Vẫn Giàu Lòng Vị Tha (Altruism & Compassion)?

Đề bài: Some people believe that modern society has made individuals more selfish and isolated, while others argue that people still have a strong sense of empathy and community spirit. Discuss both views and give your opinion (100 - 130 words).

Tiêu chuẩn Tổng duyệt Chặng 5: Sử dụng Câu chẻ nhấn mạnh (What... is...), Đảo ngữ (Not only do/does..., but... also...), liên từ nhượng bộ (Despite / Although) và ít nhất 6 từ vựng Unit 25.
